## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Reference related issues if applicable.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Include screenshots for UI changes. For question or
policy changes, include the model version and live observations, or state that live evaluation
was not run.

- [ ] Offline tests pass (`uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -v tests`).
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Inputs, screenshots, fixtures, and traces contain no API keys or private data.
